projects.name: FoundersLab
projects.description: An online incubator that connects founders with investors, mentors, and the resources to grow — from idea to funded momentum.
highlights: Full-stack SaaS platform where founders build a profile.
Machine-learning based startup scoring system.
Founders are matched with relevant investors and mentors.
Deployed on a personal private cloud with CI/CD and observability.

projects.name: StackPilot
projects.description: A private cloud infrastructure built to host production platforms — provisioned, automated, and monitored end to end.
highlights: Private OpenStack cloud infrastructure.
Infrastructure as code with Terraform and Ansible.
Kubernetes orchestration for services.
Hosts and deploys the FoundersLab platform.

projects.name: AutoMatch
projects.description: A real-time Machine Learning API for car valuation and prediction.
highlights: Real-time ML API with classification, regression and clustering models.
Dynamic Next.js frontend for prediction visualization.
Deployed on Vercel with seamless API integration.

projects.name: AI Psychometric Assessment Platform

highlights: Automated analysis pipelines for assessment data.
AI-assisted profile reports.
Guided, multilingual assessment flows.

projects.name: FITSYNC
projects.description: A sports management platform for tournaments, teams, and athlete performance.
highlights: Tournament and team management modules.
Athlete performance tracking.
Modern, interactive JavaFX interfaces.

projects.name: FYP Cooked
projects.description: Your FYP, explained. A private AI analysis of the reels you actually watch — no guesses, just the algorithm's receipts. A browser extension that analyzes each Instagram Reel with on-device AI and shows exactly what your feed is doing to your brain, all locally.
highlights: Brainrot Index: real-time score of how algorithmically cooked your feed is (0–100).
Touch Grass Score: a reality check on how much time you're actually spending scrolling.
Your Wrapped: a polished, story-like recap of your weekly feed vibe.
AI Breakdown: each reel scored on hook power, educational value, brainrot level, and more.
Gallery: every reel you've watched, filterable by mood, category, cooked score, and date.
Personalized recommendations based on your actual viewing patterns.
Achievements: unlock badges as you watch (or don't watch).
